answer: Treat each new identity as an inlet that must bond scarce compute and a time-locked deposit before it can attest. Peer panels form a reef of independent graders; correlated clones share timing and wording fingerprints and get slash-scored. A lone sparrow identity can earn reputation cheaply, but a sybil flock pays deposit times N plus lost bond when the panel flags coordination, so attack cost scales linearly with fake count rather than staying near zero.
